conditions.evidence: Ultrasound data of a variety of liver masses
conditions.label: liver masses

modalities.evidence: Ultrasound data was obtained on a variety of state of the art ultrasound scanners
reference standard used for lesion characterization included tissue pathology

output.population: Patients with liver masses enrolled in two ongoing clinical trials of contrast-enhanced ultrasound
output.summary: B-mode and contrast-enhanced ultrasound images and cine-loops of liver masses from two ongoing clinical trials, with tissue pathology and cross-sectional imaging as reference standards and treatment response after transarterial chemoembolization for many cases.
